model.name: ACnet2 (Beeman) pyramidal cell soma with Traub 1991 channels (pyr_soma_m_in_b_in)
model.citation: Beeman D (2013). A modeling study of cortical waves in primary auditory cortex. BMC Neuroscience 14(Suppl 1):P23. doi:10.1186/1471-2202-14-S1-P23 | channels (per channel-file notes): Traub RD, Wong RK, Miles R, Michelson H (1991). A model of a CA3 hippocampal pyramidal neuron incorporating voltage-clamp data on intrinsic conductances. Journal of Neurophysiology 66(2):635-650. doi:10.1152/jn.1991.66.2.635
model.expected_behavior: Single segment (d 23 um, L 17 um). Na_pyr 120, Kdr_pyr 80, Ca_pyr 10 (fixed erev 80 mV), Kahp_pyr 2.5, leak 0.142 mS/cm2; Cm 2.84 uF/cm2; Ca_conc pool. Harness: +0.2 nA 100-600 ms. Shipped reference for the jNeuroML OMV test (.test.mep): 8 spikes, ISI 18.3, 27.9, 107.7 ms, then about 76 ms (strong early adaptation into slow regular firing). Not simulated in this sweep.
model.inclusion_reason: Pilot 2 model (D-053): eligible under all 13 curation criteria in campaign curation-v3; selected for source, channel-composition and response diversity, not for any detection outcome
